normalizations.ordering: sets/lists are canonically sorted where the forward algorithm is order-insensitive; the emitted trace must then match exactly
normalizations.timing: wall-clock time is excluded; tau is deterministic operation count
normalizations.serialization: canonical JSON uses sorted keys and compact separators for hashing

failure_rule: any material mismatch on any preregistered trace field for any pre-freeze probe => N_trace=0 => D_pre_activation=FAIL
